scenes.heading: CRAFT ANYTHING STUDIES APPS
scenes.say: Can Craft Anything study an app and build its own version?

scenes.heading: STUDY BEFORE IT BUILDS
scenes.sub: It inspects the original first, using real tools, not guesses.
scenes.say: It studies the original first, with real inspection tools, before any AI writes a line.

scenes.heading: THEN AN AGENT BUILDS
scenes.sub: You name the stack, and the agent builds the new project in it.
scenes.say: Then a coding agent builds a new project, in the language or framework you ask for.

scenes.heading: CHECKED, NOT GUESSED
scenes.sub: Anything that does not match is listed until the build is close.
scenes.say: Every build is checked against the original, at three screen widths, and mismatches are listed.

scenes.heading: AGENTS DRIVE THE SAME ENGINE
scenes.sub: Any agent can call the tools the app uses, with no AI needed to inspect.
scenes.say: Every tool is a command line call and an MCP tool, so an agent can drive the same engine the app uses.

scenes.heading: THE CATCH
scenes.sub: Early alpha: check the build against the original.
